task_production_rates.name: Inspect Wall Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection of wall surfaces with raking work light. QT2 uses this same task but at faster pace (~2000 SF/hr) with quick walk-through and major defects only. QT4 uses separate TSK_WALL_INSPECT_QT4 task with comprehensive inspection.

task_production_rates.name: Inspect Wall Surface (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Detailed wall inspection with raking work light. Mark all imperfections including minor ridges.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Wall Drywall Dust
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: HEPA vacuum with brush attachment, top to bottom systematic coverage.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Freehand brush cut-in at ceiling line. QT2 uses same task at faster pace (~120 LF/hr) due to relaxed precision - minor wavering acceptable if coverage complete. QT4 uses separate TSK_WALL_CUT_IN_CEILING_QT4 task with crisp edge requirement.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In Ceiling Edge (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Careful wall brush cut-in for crisp straight line at ceiling edge.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Wall
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Single journeyman, 9-inch roller, smooth drywall wall. Work in W pattern, maintain wet edge.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Textured Wall
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Textured wall surface with 1/2-inch nap roller. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for knockdown.

task_production_rates.name: Roll Primer on Wall (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Premium wall roller application with uniform mil thickness.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup (Full Room)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Full room floor coverage with rosin paper or plastic for spray method. Tape seams.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Teardown
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Fold and remove floor protection. Faster than setup.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Setup (Perimeter)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Position drop cloths along wall perimeter for roll method.

task_production_rates.name: Floor Protection Teardown (Perimeter)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pick up perimeter drops. Fast task.

task_production_rates.name: Cover Fixtures for Spray
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Apply covers to outlets/switches. Rate is per room (~6 fixtures/room). Approximately 4 minutes per room.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Fixture Covers
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove fixture covers. Faster than setup.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Wall
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Airless spray at proper mil thickness. Spray directly into wall-to-ceiling corner when ceiling is primed â€” no cut-in needed.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Primer on Wall (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Premium wall spray with consistent mil thickness.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Backroll wall immediately after spray with 18-inch roller (9-inch acceptable in tight spaces). MANDATORY for primer on bare drywall.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer (Textured)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Backroll textured wall with 1/2" nap roller. Do NOT use 3/4" nap for knockdown.

task_production_rates.name: Backroll Sprayed Wall Primer (Premium)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Premium wall backroll with stipple elimination.

task_production_rates.name: Final Wall Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walking inspection of completed wall primer with raking light.

task_production_rates.name: Vacuum Floor After Prime
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Quick vacuum of floor area to remove debris from priming phase.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Tools
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clean brushes, rollers, spray equipment with water. Fixed time per job session.

quality_tier_effects.description: Minimal wall prime â€” reduced prep intensity, basic coverage
quality_tier_effects.notes: Economy work: quick inspection (major defects only, ambient light), coverage-priority cut-in (minor wobble acceptable), quick final inspection. Application quality is NOT reduced - drips/sags/holidays still fail. Per Modifier_Registry and Quality_Tiers_and_Surface_Condition doctrine.

quality_tier_effects.description: Standard wall prime â€” baseline for all rates
quality_tier_effects.notes: Standard new construction: proper prep, single coat, clean edges

quality_tier_effects.description: Premium wall prime â€” thorough prep, careful application, crisp edges
quality_tier_effects.notes: Premium work: detailed inspection, straight edges, possible light sand

height_effects.notes: Step ladder needed for ceiling-line cut-in and upper wall areas.
Extension ladder or scaffold required for upper wall work.
Scaffold or lift required. Significant productivity loss.

texture_effects.notes: Baseline â€” smooth Level 4 drywall wall
Orange peel texture increases surface area ~10%, slows application ~10%
Knockdown texture increases surface area ~15%, slows application ~15%. Use 1/2" nap, NOT 3/4".

drywall_level_effects.notes: Level 3 has more exposed paper, higher absorption, slightly slower application
Level 5 is uniform surface, slightly better coverage, but may require sand after prime

coupling_constraints.description: When using spray+backroll on walls, spray rate must not exceed backroll rate. Backroller sets the pace.
coupling_constraints.practical_implication: Wall spray at 600 SF/hr, wall backroll at 400 SF/hr means effective rate is 400 SF/hr per crew
coupling_constraints.notes: Spray and backroll typically done by 2-person crew. 18-inch roller typical to maximize backroll throughput.

crew_configurations.name: Single Wall Roller
crew_configurations.notes: One person does wall cut-in and rolling

crew_configurations.name: Wall Roller Pair
crew_configurations.notes: Cutter stays ahead of roller for larger wall areas

crew_configurations.name: Wall Spray + Backroll Crew
crew_configurations.notes: Sprayer and backroller work in tandem. Backroller sets pace. 18-inch roller typical, 9-inch acceptable in tight spaces.

critical_constraints.spray_only_prohibited: Spray-only is NEVER a valid application method for primer on bare drywall. Backroll is MANDATORY.
critical_constraints.roller_nap_warning: Use 1/2" nap for orange peel and knockdown. Do NOT use 3/4" nap â€” that's only for stomp/popcorn or porous masonry.
critical_constraints.no_ceiling_masking: Do NOT mask drywall ceilings when working on walls. Cut in (roll method) or spray into corner (spray+backroll when ceiling is primed).
